title: Eight Sleep header
description: A fixed two-tier header: a 42px blue promo strip in small spaced caps, then a dark frosted bar with a plain wordmark, three small uppercase links, log in, a cart icon and a small white shop button. After ~300px of scroll the promo strip tucks away upward (the bar slides up 42px with it). On phones the links move into a dropdown menu.
notes: fixed: it overlays the top of the page, so the first section should leave ~106px (or ~64px without a promo) of room or sit behind it like the hero
the bar is dark-scoped glass, made for photo or sky heroes; the tuck is a CSS scroll-driven animation (no JavaScript); the menu toggle needs JavaScript
